messages:
samir: FYI after upgrading @redwood/inference-js 2.1.0 -> 2.2.0 our Vite+Svelte kit build ballooned (+520KB) and the Vercel Edge function fails at runtime with "createClient is not a function"

marta: ugh. do you have a small repro or the build trace? :eyes:

samir: quick log from the edge runtime:
```
Edge Runtime Error
TypeError: createClient is not a function
    at /var/runtime/handler.js:12:34
    at async handleRequest (edge-server.js:45:12)
```
and our app bundle shows a big chunk flagged as `@redwood/inference-js/dist/cjs` in the analyzer.

zach: did you import the SDK via default import? e.g. `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js'` ? that can cause CJS interop to pull the whole CJS build into the ESM bundle.

samir: we use `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js'` in a handful of helper files (legacy pattern). changing to `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-js'` didn't fix the size, still huge. Also noticed the package.json in the SDK has "sideEffects": false at root which seems suspicious since the SDK uses a small runtime initializer file.

elena: sideEffects false + dynamic require/conditional exports is a trap. If the package has a file that must run on import (registers default fetch or polyfills some runtime hooks), bundlers will happily drop it when they think it's unused. That could produce missing runtime behavior as well as weird interop.

samir: here's the SDK package.json excerpt from node_modules (2.2.0):
```
{
  "name": "@redwood/inference-js",
  "main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
  "module": "dist/esm/index.js",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "sideEffects": false,
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
    },
    "./runtime": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/runtime.js",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/runtime.js"
    }
  }
}
```
ryan: that `./runtime` entry is the one that patches the environment (small side-effecty file). marking `sideEffects:false` at the package root is incorrect unless you list the runtime file in an allowlist. bundlers will assume it's safe to drop. Also, some bundlers treat `module`/`import` as primary and will keep `require` shape which triggers CJS interop helpers that bloat the bundle.

marta: can you try adding "@redwood/inference-js/dist/cjs/runtime.js" to your project's `optimizeDeps.exclude` or set `build.commonjsOptions.include` to force esbuild to handle it? for vite/ssr there are a few hacks.

samir: quick hack: pinning to 2.1.0 fixes both size and runtime. workaround that for now. I can also change imports to `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-js/esm'` and that reduces size but it's ugly for consumers.

zach: we should open a bug. Maintainers need to either remove `sideEffects:false` or explicitly mark the runtime file in `sideEffects` allowlist, and ensure ESM build doesn't require CJS interop helpers for the default export. Also check `types` path — our TS emits look wrong when files are pruned, we had missing type exports in downstream projects.

samir: created a minimal repro: https://codesandbox.io/s/rw-inference-repro-abc123 (link)
Steps:
1) `npm i @redwood/inference-js@2.2.0`
2) import default in a tiny vite app `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js'`
3) build + deploy to vercel edge -> error

elena: thanks — I can reproduce. Confirming tree: the `dist/esm/index.js` re-exports `default` from CJS via `createCommonjsModule` shim in our published bundle (rollup + cjs interop) — that shim prevents tree-shaking and pulls the whole cjs bundle into ESM consumers.

ci-bot: Ticket created: INF-3421 — "js sdk: incorrect sideEffects + cjs interop causes bundle bloat + edge runtime error" assigned to eng-devex. :white_check_mark:

ryan: short-term guidance for app teams: 1) pin to 2.1.x, 2) prefer named imports from `@redwood/inference-js/esm` if you can, 3) add the runtime file to your bundler allowlist. We should add a troubleshooting note to the SDK upgrade guide.

marta: I'll follow up with a PR template for the SDK: either list the runtime file in `sideEffects` (recommended) or remove the flag and document the tradeoffs. Also need a tests matrix: vite/esbuild/webpack + node/edge to catch regressions.

samir: thanks all. will keep pinned for now. will update if the infra team ships a patch. :thumbsup:
